mythology: Sati's upper elbow (Kurpara) dropped here; Lord Shiva gave Devi the title 'Harasiddhi' (fulfiller of Shiva's intentions) after She defeated the wicked demons Chanda and Prachanda.
pilgrimage_significance: One of the 13th Shakti Peethas located adjacent to the Mahakaleshwar Jyotirlinga; legendary spiritual source for Emperor Vikramaditya and poet Kalidasa.
historical_notes: Mentioned in the Skanda Purana (Avantika Khanda); center of Greenwich meridian of ancient Indian astronomy.
